waypoint's MCP server

Streamable HTTP at /mcp, stateless, answering JSON. Every request takes a bearer token, as the API does, and may send x-actor: each tool is one API request made with them, so it is refused, recorded and answered as that request would be. A refusal comes back as the tool's error, with the API's status and words. The contract is mcp.json; the API's is here.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "waypoint": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4400/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer wp_…"
      }
    }
  }
}

Instructions

What the server tells an agent when it connects:

waypoint: A task tracker with dependency and status management. - status is backlog, in_progress, review, done or cancelled; done and cancelled are the closed statuses. - A task depends on the tasks in its dependsOn, and is blocked by those still open (blockedBy). It is ready when it is in backlog and every task it depends on is closed. - A task can move to in_progress, review or done once every task it depends on is closed, and to done once every criterion is met and every subtask is closed. Subtasks follow the same rule among themselves. - In update_task, criteria and subtasks are whole lists matched by id; a field left out of an entry keeps its value. To mark one criterion met, send met: true on that entry only. - A task ID may be given as its shortId.

Tools

  • list_tasks List tasks
  • create_task Create a task
  • get_task Get a task
  • update_task Update a task

  • list_comments List comments

  • get_label Get a label

list_tasks reads only

Returns tasks matching every filter given, oldest first. Cancelled tasks are left out unless status is cancelled or includeCancelled is true.

InputTypeRequired
statusbacklog, in_progress, review, done, cancelledOnly tasks with this status.
readybooleantrue for only tasks that can be started now.
labelstringOnly tasks with this label, by ID or name.
assigneestringOnly tasks assigned to this; none for unassigned tasks.
dependsOnstringOnly tasks that depend on this task, by its ID or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long.
qstringOnly tasks whose title or description contains this text, ignoring case.
includeCancelledbooleantrue to include cancelled tasks.
maxResultsintegerThe most results to return. Default 100.
nextTokenstringThe nextToken from the previous page.

create_task

Creates a task in backlog, unless status says otherwise.

InputTypeRequired
titlestringyesA short name for the task.
descriptionstringWhat the task is, in Markdown.
statusbacklog, in_progress, review, done, cancelledWhere it stands. done and cancelled are the closed statuses.
dependsOnstring[]The IDs of the tasks this one depends on.
subtasksobject[]The steps of the work, in order. On update this is the whole list: a subtask left out is removed.
criteriaobject[]The acceptance criteria, in order. On update this is the whole list: a criterion left out is removed.
labelsstring[]Labels, each by ID or name.
assigneestring or nullWho the task is assigned to; null for no one.
verificationobject or nullWho checks the task's work and when; null to say nothing of it.
clientTokenstringA unique string; retrying with it returns what the first request created.

get_task reads only

Returns a task.

InputTypeRequired
taskIdstringyesThe task's ID, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

update_task

Changes the fields given. Cancelling a task cancels its open subtasks.

InputTypeRequired
taskIdstringyesThe task's ID, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
titlestringA short name for the task.
descriptionstringWhat the task is, in Markdown.
statusbacklog, in_progress, review, done, cancelledWhere it stands. done and cancelled are the closed statuses.
dependsOnstring[]The IDs of the tasks this one depends on.
subtasksobject[]The steps of the work, in order. On update this is the whole list: a subtask left out is removed.
criteriaobject[]The acceptance criteria, in order. On update this is the whole list: a criterion left out is removed.
labelsstring[]Labels, each by ID or name.
assigneestring or nullWho the task is assigned to; null for no one.
verificationobject or nullWho checks the task's work and when; null to say nothing of it.

delete_task

Deletes a task no other task depends on. To close a task instead, set its status to cancelled.

InputTypeRequired
taskIdstringyesThe task's ID, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
